gauges.provisional_fixture: All original nodes with z exactly equal to mesh zmin; no geometric tolerance and no service-bore anchors

uniform_gauge_values: All six DOF explicitly prescribed from u=epsilon*(x-xA), including nonzero By if needed; no rigid-rotation fitting.
incompatible_field: alpha*(T(Z)-300)=-1e-4*((Z-Zmin)/H)^2, isotropic; prescribed equivalent eigenstrain, not an LPBF temperature history
field_interpolation: Nodal samples of a quadratic target; actual integration uses the unchanged CCX element thermal interpolation.
remaining_constraints: Six pure rigid-mode gauges only; exact determinant nonzero
